name: Pringles - South African Style Periperi Flavour
ingredients_raw: Dried Potato (44%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil), Corn Flour, Starch, Peri Peri Seasoning (6.5%) [Maltodextrin, Salt, Sugar, Flavouring Substances (Natural & Nature Identical), Vegetable Powder (5%) (Garlic), Vinegar, Spices (Red Chilli Pepper (3%), Cumin), Acidity Regulator (INS 296), Flavour Enhancer (INS 635), Anticaking Agents (INS 341(iii), 551), Spice Extracts (0.6%) (Green Chilli, Garlic, Paprika), Herb Extract (Oregano)], Emulsifier (INS 471), Maltodextrin, Acidity
